body.name: \(\mathscr D\)
body.construction: From \((P^0,\ldots,P^n)\), compute every \(R_i\) and \(D_{ji}\), form \(H_D=\{j\to i:D_{ji}>0\}\), select a topological ordering of \(H_D\), construct every coordinate \(U_i=C_i(L_i\mid L_{B_i})\), and align environment \(i\) with \(U_i\). For each \(i\), range over all subsets \(A\subseteq B_i\), evaluate \(U_i\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}_{P^0}U_{B_i\setminus A}\mid U_A\) under the observational law \(P^0\), and return the environment-label DAG whose parent set at \(i\) is the unique inclusion-minimal subset satisfying this conditional independence.
